long_markdown_pdf_fix_20261014.summary: PDF renders long Markdown page by page, cloning blocks intersecting the current page. Page ranges are planned before rendering so progress totals include keep-together early breaks accurately. Progress is live; timeout scales with actual planned page count and caps at 15 minutes. A stalled html2canvas page now races job cancellation so lock, editor close, file switch, and timeout settle the export. PNG remains a single long image with a 10,000 CSS-pixel cap.
evidence: node scripts/markdown-download-export.test.js (includes a four-page keep-together fixture and a stalled-render cancellation case)
long_markdown_pdf_fix_20261014.browser: Native system Safari loaded the current markdown-export.js?v=3 plus the actual bundled html2canvas 1.4.1 and jsPDF 4.2.1 from a loopback-only minimal static test site. It rendered and triggered a download for a generated 1,000-section Markdown document; progress reached 154 pages, and Safari Downloads showed long-markdown-1000-sections.pdf at 120.2 MB. pdfinfo independently confirmed 154 A4 pages, 120194279 bytes, Creator jsPDF 4.2.1. First-page layout was visually checked. This is actual system-browser renderer/download evidence, but it does not exercise the authenticated Aide editor's export-menu integration, inspect the last page visually, or measure peak memory. Earlier 243-line production download remains separate evidence whose source revision is unknown.
